method: Built-in image_gen guided by the user's designated Somma background north star.
scope: Generated environment reconstruction, not a captured panorama. Visible architecture follows the reference; unseen sides, rear and perspective are plausible generated interpretation. Contains no cocktail.
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: 2:1 full spherical environment panorama for the blurred distant bar background and lighting of a live 3D cocktail viewer.
Reference image 1 is the user's explicit north-star photograph of Bar Somma. Reconstruct the visible architecture and lighting faithfully as the front-facing central direction of a full 360 x 180 degree latitude-longitude equirectangular panorama: long narrow high-ceilinged room, warm muted ochre plaster walls, tall arched window at the far end with cool blue evening city beyond, a line of delicate pendant lamps, softly lit shelves/cabinetry on the left, restrained bowl-shaped sconces and mirrors on the right, the curved rust-brown stone bar. Preserve the reference's understated warm natural atmosphere and real photographic materials, not a dark walnut speakeasy.
The camera is at cocktail photography height just above the bar counter. The final cocktail and its nearby counter surface will be actual3D objects added separately; leave no cocktail or close objects in this panorama. Keep all depicted furnishings several meters away; do not put a close tabletop across the bottom half. Unseen side/back directions should be a plausible continuation of the ochre room; do not invent distinctive branded features. The front room/arched window direction should be centered horizontally. Level spherical horizon. Continuous left/right wrap; top pole softly lit ceiling and bottom subdued floor.
Lighting: photographic, warm cream/amber practicals with restrained blue dusk window fill. Protect highlights, keep darker regions gently open rather than black, no theatrical orange saturation, no giant glowing light panels. Favor soft neutral-warm light on objects in front of this backdrop.
Distant interior should be subtly out of focus with genuine optical blur, maintaining readable broad shapes of the arch, pendants and shelves. A later renderer will add extra defocus so do not turn the room into featureless bokeh blobs. The cocktail will be the only sharp focal subject. No people, no close drinking glasses or cocktails, no signage, no words, no logos, no watermark. Highly convincing real interior photograph. Exact2:1 equirectangular image, highest available detail.
